reviewMethod: Single-developer static review of named conditions in author-attributed AI-assisted apps. Not independent security ground truth, not live exploit validation. Grade C applies to whole apps; no Grade A CVE pair or executed Grade B repair pair is claimed.

cases.condition: Request-selected server environment value returned to caller
cases.evidence: Request JSON supplies environment variable name; Deno environment lookup result is placed in JSON response without an in-function allowlist or authorization check.
cases.limitations: Deployment, gateway JWT configuration, environment contents and caller permissions were not tested. A login gateway alone does not prove authorization to read server secrets.
cases.fixDirection: Remove the general secret-export endpoint; keep provider secrets in server-side proxy operations. Do not return secret values to browsers.
cases.verification: Use synthetic server secrets in an authorized isolated test; assert unauthenticated and ordinary-user calls never return them; rerun static analysis.

cases.condition: Speech input does not directly choose HTTP authority
cases.evidence: Voice identifier interpolates only after a fixed HTTPS authority and path prefix; text is sent as JSON body. This named path is not evidence of a user-controlled host.
cases.limitations: Redirect behavior, provider behavior, URL normalization edge cases, quota abuse and gateway controls unverified. Deno request handlers are outside current flow contracts.
cases.fixDirection: Keep fixed destination, validate allowed voice identifiers and bound input and service usage.
cases.verification: Pair fixed-origin/body-input tests with fully user-controlled destination tests in a future Deno adapter; no real network requests needed.

cases.condition: Paid-service request authorization and quota coverage
cases.evidence: Speech handler uses a server environment key and accepts request content; local handler contains no user or quota check. Repository config does not establish live gateway access policy.
cases.limitations: Absence of an in-function check is not proof of unauthenticated live access. Deployment policy and rate limits unknown.
cases.fixDirection: Verify gateway authentication plus per-user authorization and quota controls before enabling paid requests.
cases.verification: In staging with fake provider responses, test anonymous denial and user budget limits; never call the provider during this benchmark.

cases.condition: Chart CSS injection requires configuration provenance
cases.evidence: The flagged JSX sink generates style content from chart configuration, not directly from request text. This warning alone does not establish XSS.
cases.limitations: All possible chart configuration callers and trusted-value constraints were not proved. Shared UI component also occurs in other pilot apps.
cases.fixDirection: Trace dynamic color/configuration origins; constrain CSS values if untrusted configuration can reach this component.
cases.verification: Test hostile configuration only in an isolated synthetic component and preserve normal static-theme controls.

cases.condition: Browser playground has a bounded dedicated-worker lifecycle
cases.evidence: Playground creates a browser Worker and terminates it on completion, failure or a two-second timer; this is client-side sample execution, not confirmed server eval.
cases.limitations: No claim of complete sandbox safety. Worker network/storage access, browser resource exhaustion and CSP interactions require separate review. Embedded HTML scripts lack current AST flow inspection.
cases.fixDirection: Preserve termination and audit worker capabilities and content-security policy independently.
cases.verification: Future browser fixture should assert worker termination and escaped output without executing downloaded source in this evaluation.

cases.condition: Worker result and error HTML insertion has explicit escaping
cases.evidence: Displayed result, type and error strings pass through escHtml before HTML insertion.
cases.limitations: Only these output sites reviewed; other HTML insertions and escHtml completeness are separate conditions. Embedded client JavaScript is not server-flow coverage.
cases.fixDirection: Retain escaping or use textContent for untrusted text.
cases.verification: Synthetic rendering tests should include markup delimiters and quotes; do not infer the entire application is XSS-free.

cases.condition: Shared chart style warning lacks untrusted-data proof
cases.evidence: Pattern warning targets a generated CSS style block driven by component configuration.
cases.limitations: Shared scaffolding is correlated with other apps, not an independent vulnerability sample; configuration reachability unverified.
cases.fixDirection: Require caller/value-origin evidence before describing a confirmed exploitable XSS path.
cases.verification: Compare fixed configuration, untrusted configuration and unused component cases.

cases.condition: Checked-in chat and task policies express owner-scoped access
cases.evidence: Migration enables RLS and checks authenticated identity against user_id for both USING and WITH CHECK on named tables.
cases.limitations: SQL policy semantics are not currently analyzed by the engine; deployment, later policies, grants, security-definer code and service-role bypass are not proved.
cases.fixDirection: Preserve ownership checks and verify the complete effective policy set in an authorized staging environment.
cases.verification: Test two users reading, inserting and changing each other's rows after applying the exact migration sequence in a separate environment.

cases.condition: Live database policy cannot be certified by checked-in SQL
cases.evidence: Repository has policy definitions, but no read-only deployment verification was authorized or performed.
cases.limitations: The benchmark has no cloud access or database state. This is not a missed confirmed vulnerability or a clean result.
cases.fixDirection: Display declared policy versus verified deployment status separately.
cases.verification: User-approved staging isolation tests and effective-policy inspection are needed; no production query was made.

cases.condition: Public client accepts key formats but actual injected key is unknown
cases.evidence: Client references a publishable-key environment setting; format helper also recognizes a secret-key family. No actual injected credential was acquired or tested.
cases.limitations: An environment variable name or helper branch does not prove secret exposure. Public anon/publishable keys are not secrets by default; any JWT-shaped source files were omitted conservatively at acquisition.
cases.fixDirection: Reject server-only key families in browser configuration and document allowed public settings without claiming deployed values are known.
cases.verification: Use fake public and secret-shaped values in future client/server boundary tests; never validate real keys.

cases.condition: Theme preference storage is not credential persistence
cases.evidence: Named localStorage calls store a theme selection rather than a password, JWT or server key.
cases.limitations: Other authentication storage paths are separate; absence of a warning is not full client-data-flow negative evidence.
cases.fixDirection: Keep security-token storage review separate from harmless display preferences.
cases.verification: Future storage-source tests should pair theme values and actual authentication-token provenance.

cases.condition: Translated UI labels are not hardcoded credentials
cases.evidence: All five flagged values are static localization labels or marketing headings under translation resources, not credentials or signing material.
cases.limitations: This verifies only the five named warnings, not every value in the file. One grouped fix cause, not five independent project risks.
cases.fixDirection: Future engine work should distinguish UI text dictionaries from secret values using syntax and use context, not repository names.
cases.verification: Keep translation labels as normal controls alongside synthetic actual credential-use and ambiguous dictionary cases.

cases.condition: Named redirect does not use request-selected destination
cases.evidence: Helper builds the destination from SITE_URL server configuration plus a fixed path and literal success/error result; request code and state are not the destination.
cases.limitations: Administrator-controlled SITE_URL correctness and safe HTML/JavaScript embedding are separate questions; no claim of complete OAuth safety.
cases.fixDirection: Future redirect rules should trace destination origin and distinguish request-controlled addresses from deployment configuration.
cases.verification: Pair configured destinations with request-controlled redirect targets; retain tests for unsafe configured string embedding separately.

cases.condition: Named signup terms HTML comes from fixed translation resources
cases.evidence: Translation lookup uses a constant terms-label key without interpolation arguments; i18n initializes from checked-in resource dictionaries rather than a remote backend.
cases.limitations: Only this non-interpolated location is classified. Other HTML sites with database-derived interpolation need separate provenance checks.
cases.fixDirection: Use normal React markup for static translated terms where feasible; do not present this fixed-resource site as proven user-controlled XSS.
cases.verification: Static label should remain a normal control; a synthetic user-supplied translation or interpolation must not be suppressed.

cases.condition: Admin endpoint contains separate authentication and role checks
cases.evidence: Manual review confirms missing/invalid identity rejection via getUser and role-RPC-error/false-admin rejection before action dispatch. The actual worker file record is LIMIT_EXCEEDED with flow NOT_RUN, so automated absence is not a true negative.
cases.limitations: This verifies presence and ordering of the named checks only. RPC definition, effective database permissions and service-role operations require complete policy review. Beyond this run's resource exclusion, Deno and Supabase authorization contracts are also unsupported.
cases.fixDirection: Preserve both identity validation and authorization, rather than treating a valid JWT alone as admin proof.
cases.verification: Future tests should distinguish invalid identity, ordinary user, admin, failed role lookup and bypassed guard paths using synthetic data; verify file selection coverage separately.

cases.condition: Published container port requires deployment context
cases.evidence: Existing deployment analyzer emits a REVIEW_REQUIRED candidate for a host port mapping without explicit loopback bind.
cases.limitations: This is not proof of internet reachability, vulnerable content or a missing proxy/firewall. Runtime network configuration unknown.
cases.fixDirection: Confirm intended exposure, reverse proxy, authentication and network rules before choosing an interface binding.
cases.verification: Check configuration in an authorized nonproduction deployment; this benchmark sends no network probes.

failurePacks.confirmedGap: Parsed Echoverse Deno callbacks establish no supported entrypoint. CopyMonster's admin file was not parsed due to source limits. These are separate scope gaps, not evidence that either environment-response or authorization path was verified safe.
failurePacks.hypothesis: A provenance-checked Deno/Supabase entry adapter plus environment-response evidence could reuse existing TypeScript values and traces. File selection is a separate bounded-coverage design question.
failurePacks.remediationContract: Remove generic environment export. A future controlled copy must never return server environment contents for an ordinary request; preserve server proxy key use.
failurePacks.notPerformed: No fixed source copy executed or compared; no live access or exploit claimed.

failurePacks.confirmedGap: Five translated labels become HIGH secret warnings after False Positive Reduction.
failurePacks.hypothesis: AST value/use context could separate localization resources from actual credential assignments across projects.
failurePacks.remediationContract: This is an analyzer false positive: do not ask users to delete legitimate translation text. Add normal/risky/unknown synthetic dictionary controls in a future engine change.

failurePacks.confirmedGap: Existing pattern signals do not establish request control; configured destination and fixed terms produce two verified false-positive warning groups, while chart configuration remains unknown.
failurePacks.hypothesis: Client/server boundary and value-origin proof should precede automatic suppression; do not ignore all translation or style sinks.
failurePacks.remediationContract: Future repair evidence must include exact sink, input origin and trusted-resource constraints, not merely rule names.

failurePacks.confirmedGap: Policy files and client key contracts are present but effective Supabase authorization semantics and live state are not verified.
failurePacks.hypothesis: A bounded migration-policy inventory with explicit deployment UNKNOWN would be useful before attempting complete RLS reasoning.
failurePacks.remediationContract: Capture table/action/identity predicate, migration order and two-user tests; do not treat a public key as server-secret exposure.

v1AcceptanceProposal.initialStack: React/Vite browser plus bounded Deno/Supabase server functions, because this pilot directly supplies source and contrasting server checks. TanStack dynamic delegation remains unknown. Next.js needs separately acquired evidence before claiming coverage.
deepRiskContracts: Verified caller identity versus resource authorization
Request-controlled destination versus fixed service URL
Untrusted HTML versus fixed display resources
v1AcceptanceProposal.confirmedVersusReview: Only statically demonstrated named paths may get a confirmed-path label. Live RLS, deployment, gateway policy and exploitability require user verification; existing Risk policy is unchanged.
v1AcceptanceProposal.independentEvaluationGate: Before release of each contract, reserve new repository/prompt/clone families not used to implement it, include dangerous/safe/unknown pairs, review truth separately if possible, and report both supported-scope errors and whole-target uninspected coverage. Sample counts and acceptable error thresholds need joint approval; no numeric accuracy target is justified by this pilot.
remediationWorkspaceEvidence: Immutable source SHA and affected-file hash
Named source/sink or policy predicate and exact location
Observed guards and unresolved deployment assumptions
Minimal proposed change kept separate from original
Synthetic negative and positive checks plus same-snapshot rescan
User approval and no secret contents in prompts or reports
v1AcceptanceProposal.notCompleted: No new engine contract, automatic patch, generated original transcript, repaired-code comparison, hosted policy validation or new blind holdout in this milestone.
v1AcceptanceProposal.promptGroupingLimit: Prompt family identifiers describe observed application purposes, not verified original prompt transcripts. Shared component hashes are reported and cannot be counted as independent evidence.

nextPriorities.proposal: Deno/Supabase request entry and server-environment-to-response provenance
nextPriorities.basis: Confirmed dangerous static path in Echoverse and separate guarded admin path in CopyMonster provide paired contracts; live deployment remains unknown.

nextPriorities.proposal: Client/server value origins for secret, redirect and HTML warnings
nextPriorities.basis: Five localization warnings plus configured redirect and fixed terms are verified path-level false positives. Shared chart warnings remain unknown, not automatically excluded.

nextPriorities.proposal: Declared Supabase policy inventory and ownership-test evidence
nextPriorities.basis: Checked-in owner policies exist but source collection does not establish effective or deployed access control. Prioritize truthful scope over unsupported safe labels.
